blocks.text: “Dating Alys Perez” (DAP) stars Angela Muji and Rabin Angeles are ready to take their love team to the next level with a new rom-com movie to be directed by Darryl Yap. The announcement was made by Viva Films on Saturday on social media, with content creator Malupiton (real name Joel Ravanera) headlining the project. READ: What’s next for Rabin Angeles, Angela Muji after ‘Dating Alys Perez’ The movie is simply titled, “‘Ya,” short for “Kuya” (big brother). Malupiton will play Muji’s “kuya” in the movie. “Sandamakmak na tawa, sandamakmak na iyak, sandamakmak na pag-ibig! Kakampi mo habambuhay ang iyong kapatid!” […]...
